skills.name: search-startups
skills.description: Search any AI startup by name, sector, country, funding stage, and operating status.

skills.name: get-startup-profile
skills.description: Get a full startup profile including description, funding, team, competitors, and scores.

skills.name: search-investors
skills.description: Search VCs, angels, and accelerators by name, country, or investor type.

skills.name: search-people
skills.description: Search founders, executives, board members, and key team members by name, title, country, or sector.

skills.name: find-logo
skills.description: Find square and horizontal company logos by name or website URL.

skills.name: enrich-company
skills.description: AI-powered RAG enrichment: create or enrich a company profile with live web data.

skills.name: validate-email
skills.description: Verify if an email address is valid and deliverable.

skills.name: discover-email
skills.description: Find a professional email address given a person's name and company domain.

skills.name: mcp-server
skills.description: MCP server for AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf) to access StartupHub.ai data.

skills.name: submit-startup
skills.description: Submit a new startup to be listed on StartupHub.ai. Agent-friendly: strict JSON schema, third-person prose, no HTML. Submissions go to a moderation queue and become public after admin approval (typically 24h). Optional logo_url is fetched and stored automatically. Returns field-level validation errors with suggestions on bad input. Costs 5 credits.

skills.name: submit-investor
skills.description: Submit a new investor profile (VC, angel, accelerator, etc.) to StartupHub.ai. Same moderation flow as submit-startup. Deduped by website domain or name+country. Costs 5 credits.

skills.name: submit-person
skills.description: Submit a new person profile (founder, executive, board member) to StartupHub.ai. Requires either current_title or linkedin_url to disambiguate from common-name dupes. Costs 5 credits.

skills.name: submit-product
skills.description: Submit a new product, tool, API, library, agent, model, dataset, or hardware to StartupHub.ai for moderation review. Optional startup_slug links to a parent company. Strict third-person format. Optional logo_url and up to 6 screenshot_urls fetched and stored automatically. Costs 5 credits.

skills.name: submit-funding-round
skills.description: Announce a funding round for a startup you own. Strict series vocabulary, USD amount, YYYY-MM-DD date. Dedup against same-startup same-series within 7 days. Costs 5 credits.

skills.name: submit-exit-event
skills.description: Announce an IPO / Acquisition / Merger / SPAC / Buyout / Closure for a startup you own. Costs 5 credits.

skills.name: submit-research
skills.description: Submit a research paper / preprint. Optional startup link. Dedup by arxiv_id or doi. Costs 5 credits.

skills.name: submit-patent
skills.description: Submit a patent record. Required patent_number (e.g. US12345678B2). Dedup by patent_number. Costs 5 credits.

skills.name: submit-news
skills.description: Submit a news article / press release. Third-person, controlled categories, 100-10000 words. Dedup by source_url or similar title in 30 days. Costs 5 credits.
